# Mamba Venture Program (MVP)

> The Mamba Venture Program (MVP) is a venture-building program in Singapore that helps working professionals, SME owners and aspiring founders turn industry insight into a working product: validate the problem, build the MVP and test demand. It runs as a 1-month sprint (S$2,500) or a 3-month venture build (S$5,999). No equity is taken to join. It is run by Mamba Partners and Cybrdeck, with SG Innovation as ecosystem partner.

## Key facts

- MVP 1-month sprint: Test the problem, define your MVP and decide what to build next. S$2,500, or 50% upfront and the rest before the program ends.
- MVP 3-month venture build: Develop the MVP, test with users and work toward commercial readiness. S$5,999, or 50% upfront and the rest before the program ends.
- No equity is taken to join. Mamba Partners gets the first look at investing in ventures that complete the program.
- Who it's for: working professionals, SME owners and aspiring founders with industry insight, an idea or an early prototype. No company or co-founder needed.
- Next cohort: #2, starts 26 January 2027. Applications close 23 January 2027, 9am Singapore time.
- Location: Singapore.
- Run by: Mamba Partners (Mamba JJ Partners Pte. Ltd.), Cybrdeck (program lead), and SG Innovation (ecosystem partner).

## FAQ

### What is the Mamba Venture Program?

The Mamba Venture Program (MVP) is a venture-building program in Singapore that helps working professionals, SME owners and aspiring founders turn industry insight into a working product. You validate the problem, build the MVP and test demand, with engineers, operators and investors beside you. It is run by Mamba Partners and Cybrdeck, with SG Innovation as ecosystem partner.

### Who can apply?

Working professionals, SME owners and aspiring founders with industry insight, an idea or an early prototype. You don't need a company or a co-founder. Bring a problem you know first-hand.

### How much does the program cost?

The 1-month sprint is S$2,500 and the 3-month venture build is S$5,999. For either track you can pay 50% upfront and the rest before the program ends. Applying is free.

### Does MVP take equity in my startup?

No. No equity is taken to join. Mamba Partners evaluates every venture that completes the program as an investment opportunity and gets the first look, but there is no obligation either way.

### What is the difference between the 1-month sprint and the 3-month venture build?

The 1-month sprint tests the problem, defines your MVP and helps you decide what to build next. The 3-month venture build develops the MVP, tests it with users and works toward commercial readiness. Both tracks share workspace, engineering guidance, commercial support, investor sessions and ecosystem connections, and both start on the same date.

### When does the next cohort start, and when do applications close?

Cohort #2 starts on 26 January 2027. Applications close on 23 January 2027 at 9am Singapore time, 72 hours before the start.

### How does the application work?

The online application takes about 20 minutes over up to 10 short steps, and it saves as you go. We read every application and talk with shortlisted applicants about where the venture really is. Specific, honest answers count for more than polish.

### Is MVP an accelerator?

MVP is a stepping stone, not a competing accelerator. You build, test and gather evidence before your next accelerator or funding application, so you arrive with a working product and proof of demand.

### Can universities, companies or investors work with MVP?

Yes. Schools can book venture masterclasses, AI build labs and hackathon incubation tracks. Enterprises can run 48-hour AI workflow sprints and paid pilots with cohort startups. Mentors, angel investors, VC funds and ecosystem partners can join the network through the partner page, and anyone can contact the team.
